note: No commit handler exists yet, and this file does not change that (see #219 for the design and #67 for the implementation issue). This proposes the FIELD SHAPE a legacy policy row needs, not an insert path - the future commit handler must drive these fields through the real bind/issue transaction services (server/src/services/quote-bind.service.ts) or an explicit, reviewed legacy-issuance path, never a raw INSERT INTO policies. A staged row here therefore represents 'the policy as it existed at cutover', which the commit handler is responsible for replaying through the real lifecycle safely.

mapsTo.insured: policy_parties (roleCode='INSURED') -> parties, resolved via a customer import row's externalIdentifiers

fields.name: status
fields.description: Legacy status at cutover, e.g. Issued/Cancelled/Expired - drives which lifecycle replay path the commit handler must use.

fields.name: insuredExternalId
fields.description: External identifier matching a customer row imported via customer.json; resolved to a party through import_external_refs, not a direct customer_id.

fields.name: producerExternalId
fields.description: External identifier matching a producer row imported via producer.json.
